about: The source colors the guide shows when a person has none of their own, and how far one step moves a colour when they ask for a variation. A closed list: the guide never invents a colour. Each is written in OKLCH (lightness, chroma, hue) and is only a starting point: the primary color role is solved from it against the repository's own background, so every one of them reaches the contrast ratio of the conformance level.
